versions.changelog:
meeting-notes-generator v0.1.0

- Initial release of the meeting-notes-generator skill.
- Enables automated extraction and structuring of meeting notes from PDF and Word documents.
- Implements a four-step rigorous processing flow to ensure 100% information coverage and a minimum of 2000 words per summary.
- Supports detailed validation, mapping, and supplementary procedures to guarantee information integrity.
- Provides structured output in either PDF or Word, with customizable formatting options for professional appearance.
